title.zh: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report
title.en: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report

current_state.zh: Coinbase-commissioned research shows stablecoin transfer volume quadrupled to $891B in Q3 2026, with most activity outside US banking hours and growing adoption by major US banks and mid-market businesses.
